note: The raw PoC bytes form a big-endian ELF file written to the temporary input path.
libdwfl reports the file as an offline module and preserves the ELF handle for DWARF loading.
The harness asks libdwfl to construct a Dwarf descriptor from the attacker-controlled ELF.
DWARF loading scans section names from the same ELF object.
A section named .debug_info is accepted as DWARF, but its sh_type is SHT_GNU_HASH, so elf_getdata performs type conversion instead of returning raw debug bytes.
The malformed GNU hash payload has fewer than eight bytes for the 64-bit mask word, causing the old converter to return with bytes in the destination buffer left undefined.
